count_rules: Rust rows are source declarations plus labeled documentation fences, before Cargo/rustc expansion and target/feature selection.

Body read means an attributed full-body source read. Per-row scope records helper/production review limits. Proposed dispositions remain scoped.
Aggregate historical runs do not supply missing per-case receipts. Source routes into CI do not prove execution.
Body hashes follow each language extractor; file SHA-256 and pinned Git tree provide common independently verifiable identity.
